semanticSeam.authority: closed kiwe.seam-map.v1 plus inert data-seam-anchor stitches
semanticSeam.input: approved browser-runnable HTML/CSS/JS and exact SiteGraph evidence when cited
semanticSeam.output: builder-neutral semantic contract, exact source fingerprints and proof ledger

prepareBindings.authority: participating browser AI under the SEAM command contract
prepareBindings.input: complete accepted pre-existing HTML/CSS/JS project without a strict SEAM Map, plus assets and SiteGraph whenever real site fields are requested
prepareBindings.output: kiwe.bricks-bindings.v1 graph and binding report only; approved raw project remains unchanged; never Bricks JSON

compile.trigger: explicit submission through the seam.kiwe application UI or API
compile.input: complete accepted HTML/CSS/JS project, assets and either a strict validated kiwe.seam-map.v1 or optional legacy kiwe.bricks-bindings.v1
compile.output: native Bricks page/header/footer/popup templates plus conversion evidence
compile.customCodePolicy: only when the calibrated Bricks profile proves no native equivalent

framework.input: the same complete rendered source evidence used by conversion
framework.output: one Framework Profile, profile-dependent templates and integration audit

accessibility.output: measured report or corrected same-lane artifact with before/after evidence
accessibility.creativeBoundary: preserve the accepted design; dark mode may deliberately coordinate brand, accent, surface and text roles without collapsing every surface to black

redo.authority: last accepted artifact plus failure evidence
redo.forbidden: stacking speculative patches on the failed output

invariants: Raw conversion never injects or requires Seam Framework.
Framework is an explicit option, not a command or redesign.
A missing Framework Profile fails closed and templates never depend on variable fallbacks.
Browser AI may author source design and binding intent but never production Bricks JSON or Framework Profile data.
/convert /bricks never emits Bricks JSON; seam.kiwe compilation is a separate explicit application action.
Strict SEAM Map conversion never infers dynamic, commerce, editorial, interaction or conditional meaning; missing, stale, duplicated, unproven or unresolved stitches fail closed.
SEAM Map is builder-neutral conversion context and does not apply Seam Framework or influence art direction.
Visual confidence is evidence based and never a universal fixed percentage.
Source defects are preserved in 1:1 conversion and reported separately.
No project-specific selector, brand, layout or route rule enters compiler core.
